models.name: todo_app_users
models.description: User accounts representing individuals who authenticate and manage their own todo lists. Each user has unique identity (email), secure password hash, account status tracking, and temporal audit fields. Users form the primary identity entity for the application.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication. Must follow valid email format (RFC 5322). Used as the unique login identifier for the user account.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt or Argon2. Never stored in plaintext. Used to verify user identity during authentication. Hash is generated server-side from user's plaintext password input.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current account status indicating whether user can access the system. Valid values: 'active' (user can log in and access todos), 'inactive' (user cannot log in, data preserved). Defaults to 'active' on account creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user registered and created their account. Automatically set by system at account creation time. Never changes after creation. Stored in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any user profile field (excluding session/activity fields). Automatically updated whenever user information changes. Stored in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was deleted (soft delete). NULL means account is active. When set, user cannot log in but data is preserved for audit trail and recovery. Stored in UTC timezone.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: Session records tracking authenticated user connections. Each session represents one login session with JWT token references, connection metadata (IP, device info), and expiration tracking. Enables session-per-device support and audit trail of user activity. Sessions are created on successful authentication and invalidated on logout or expiration.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to the authenticated user's {@link todo_app_users.id}. Each session belongs to exactly one user. Multiple concurrent sessions allowed per user.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the user established this session. Used for security monitoring, tracking login locations, and audit purposes. Example: '192.168.1.100' or '2001:db8::1'.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL / request URL when the session was established. Captures the entry point for the session and referrer context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page or application that led to this session creation. Used for tracking traffic sources and user journey analysis.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was established after successful user authentication. Automatically set when user logs in. Stored in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or was explicitly terminated by user logout. NULL indicates session is still active. When set, user must re-authenticate to continue using the application. Stored in UTC timezone.

models.name: todo_app_admins
models.description: Administrator accounts representing system operators with elevated permissions. Admins manage user accounts, monitor system health, access audit logs, and perform administrative maintenance. Separate from regular users table to enforce distinct admin role and permission structure. Each admin authenticates with email and password, tracked independently from regular users.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's email address for authentication and administrative communication. Must follow valid email format. Unique across admin accounts. Used as the login identifier for admin authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed admin password using bcrypt or Argon2. Never stored in plaintext. Used to verify admin identity during authentication. Generated server-side from admin's plaintext password input.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current admin account status. Valid values: 'active' (admin can log in and perform operations), 'inactive' (admin cannot log in). Controls whether admin can access the system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Automatically set by system. Never changes after account creation. Stored in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to admin profile information. Automatically updated when admin data changes. Stored in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was deleted (soft delete). NULL indicates active account. When set, admin cannot log in but account data preserved for audit trail. Stored in UTC timezone.

models.name: todo_app_admin_sessions
models.description: Session records tracking authenticated admin connections and JWT token sessions. Each session represents one admin login with shorter timeout (15 minutes inactivity) than regular user sessions for enhanced security. Tracks connection metadata (IP, referrer) for admin action audit trail. Sessions created on successful admin authentication and invalidated on logout or expiration.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to the authenticated admin's {@link todo_app_admins.id}. Each session belongs to exactly one admin. Multiple concurrent sessions allowed per admin.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin established this session. Used for security monitoring, tracking admin login locations, and audit trail of admin access points.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL when the admin session was established. Captures the entry point for the admin session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating the source that led to this admin session creation. Used for tracking admin access sources.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session was established after successful authentication. Automatically set when admin logs in. Stored in UTC timezone.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or was explicitly terminated by admin logout. NULL indicates session is still active. Admin sessions expire after 15 minutes of inactivity for security. Stored in UTC timezone.

models.name: todo_app_audit_logs
models.description: Immutable audit trail recording all administrative actions for security, compliance, and accountability. Each log entry captures what admin performed what action, on what resource, when, and from where. Append-only table - entries never modified or deleted. Used for security monitoring, compliance reporting, investigating security incidents, and tracking admin accountability per requirements in 07-admin-features.md.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to the admin who performed the action. {@link todo_app_admins.id}. Links audit entry to the specific admin responsible for the action.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key reference to the user affected by the admin action (if applicable). {@link todo_app_users.id}. NULL if action doesn't target a specific user (e.g., system configuration changes). Example: User ID of deleted user account.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action performed. Examples: 'user_created', 'user_deleted', 'user_status_changed', 'password_reset', 'config_updated', 'backup_initiated'. Enables filtering audit logs by action category.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the action performed. Captures contextual information about what the admin did and why. Example: 'User account suspended due to security violation' or 'System configuration updated: session timeout changed from 30 to 15 minutes'.

plainFields.name: before_value
plainFields.description: Previous value of the modified field (for update actions). Captured before the change was applied. NULL for create or delete actions. Enables tracking exactly what changed.

plainFields.name: after_value
plainFields.description: New value of the modified field (for update actions). Captured after the change was applied. NULL for delete actions. Enables tracking the new state after admin action.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the admin performed the action. Used for tracking admin activity location and detecting suspicious access patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the action was performed. Automatically set by system when audit log entry is created. Stored in UTC timezone for accurate timeline of admin actions.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description: Core todo item entity representing individual tasks managed by users. Each todo belongs exclusively to one user and tracks the complete lifecycle from creation through completion. Todos contain required properties (title, status) and optional properties (description, priority, due_date). Timestamps track creation, modification, and completion events. This entity is the central business object enabling users to capture, organize, and track their work.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user's {@link todo_app_users.id}. Establishes one-to-many relationship where each todo belongs to exactly one user and user can have many todos.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Required todo title/description that identifies what the user needs to do. Maximum 255 characters, must be non-empty. Primary identifier for the todo from user perspective.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed information and context about the todo. Additional notes beyond the title. Maximum 2000 characters. Can be empty if user does not provide additional details.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of the todo. Only two valid values: 'active' for incomplete todos, 'completed' for finished todos. Defaults to 'active' when created. Determines visibility in active vs completed todo lists.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Optional importance level of the todo. Valid values: 'low', 'medium', 'high'. Defaults to 'medium' if not specified by user. Helps users prioritize their work.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional target completion date for the todo in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Must not be in the past. If provided, helps users manage deadlines. Can be null when no specific deadline exists.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: System-generated timestamp in UTC when the todo was created. Immutable after creation, never changes. Records when user captured the task.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: System-generated timestamp in UTC of the most recent modification. Updated every time any field of the todo changes. Enables tracking of recent activity and recency sorting.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: System-generated timestamp in UTC when the todo was marked as completed. Only populated when status is 'completed'. Automatically cleared when status changes back to 'active'. Records when user finished the task.
